reviewer: Isolated reviewer plus trusted cycle compiler/behavior gates

functions.reason: Independently compiled the readable C++ with pinned MSVC and verified the entire unmodified code section matches the original function bytes and boundaries. Both actual compiled code and original bytes passed 1,024 receiver-pattern cases with all tested storage unchanged. The branchless routine returns 24 without accessing its receiver; its return and stack behavior agree. Approval is limited to this routine, not a complete executable rebuild.

limits: Complete native compiler fragment and byte-checked reference tested at relocated addresses
Sampled tests independently reviewed for the specific routine; not all-input equivalence or a full game run
Original 32-bit ABI; external calls/relocations require a separate qualified recipe
